elements.name: Reaper
elements.desc: Learn one necromancy cantrip from any spell list; when you cast a necromancy cantrip that targets one creature, it can instead target two creatures within 5 feet of each other.

elements.id: Class Feature:Channel Divinity: Touch of Death
elements.name: Channel Divinity: Touch of Death
elements.desc: When you hit a creature with a melee attack, use Channel Divinity to deal extra necrotic damage equal to 5 + twice your cleric level.

elements.name: Inescapable Destruction
elements.desc: Necrotic damage dealt by your cleric spells and Channel Divinity options ignores resistance to necrotic damage.

elements.name: Divine Strike (Death)
elements.desc: Once per turn, add 1d8 necrotic damage to a weapon hit (2d8 at 14th level).

elements.name: Improved Reaper
elements.desc: When you cast a necromancy spell of 1st through 5th level that targets one creature, it can instead target two creatures within 5 feet of each other.

elements.name: Oathbreaker Spells
elements.desc: Always have your oathbreaker spells prepared.

elements.name: Channel Divinity: Control Undead
elements.desc: Target one undead within 30 feet; on a failed Wisdom save it obeys your commands for 24 hours.

elements.name: Channel Divinity: Dreadful Aspect
elements.desc: Frighten creatures of your choice within 30 feet for 1 minute with a Wisdom save.

elements.name: Aura of Hate
elements.desc: You and fiends and undead within 10 feet add your Charisma modifier (minimum +1) to melee weapon damage rolls.

elements.name: Supernatural Resistance
elements.desc: Gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons.

elements.name: Dread Lord
elements.desc: Create an aura of gloom for 1 minute that dims light, burns frightened enemies, and hides your allies in shadow.
